title: Trump Taps Wife of 'God Bless the USA' Country Star Lee Greenwood for Ambassador Role
snippet: President-elect Donald Trump has nominated Kim Greenwood, former beauty queen and wife of country music icon Lee Greenwood, to serve as a U.S. ambassador.
content:
WASHINGTON — President-elect Donald Trump has named Kim Greenwood, the wife of country music legend Lee Greenwood, as his nominee for a key U.S. ambassadorial post, continuing a trend of tapping high-profile supporters for diplomatic roles in his incoming administration.

A High-Profile Nomination

Kim Greenwood, a former Miss Tennessee USA who has worked extensively in event production and pageantry, brings decades of public relations and media experience to the nomination. Her husband, Lee Greenwood, wrote and performed the iconic 1984 patriotic anthem "God Bless the USA," which has long served as the signature entrance music for Trump at his campaign rallies and political events.

Deep Ties to the Campaign

The appointment reflects Trump's inclination to reward close allies and figures who have played prominent roles in his political ecosystem. Beyond the frequent use of his anthem, the elder Greenwood collaborated with Trump earlier this year on the endorsement and distribution of a custom "God Bless the USA Bible." The ambassadorial position will require official confirmation by the U.S. Senate before Greenwood can assume the diplomatic mantle.
